results.title: AWS just raised GPU prices twice in six months. Nebius raised theirs 30%. And they're all still selling out. | Jack Skywalker
highlights:
# AWS just raised GPU prices twice in six months. Nebius raised theirs 30%. And they're all still selling out. | Jack Skywalker · LinkedIn · 2026-07-13T00:00:00+00:00

...

AWS just raised GPU prices twice in six months. Nebius raised theirs 30%. And they're all still selling out.

→ AWS raised EC2 Capacity Block prices ~15% in January. Then another ~20% on July 1. An 8x H200 node that cost $34.61/hr in December now runs $39-49/hr depending on region.

→ Nebius raised on-demand rates ~30% across H100, H200, B200, and B300 effective June 1. H100s went from $2.95 to $3.85/hr. B200s from $5.50 to $7.15.

→ DRAM contract prices jumped roughly 60% in Q2, and HBM capacity for 2026 is fully sold out. Gartner is modeling memory cost surges north of 100% with the crunch running into 2027.

results.title: GPU Cloud Comparison 2026: H100 Prices, 25+ Clouds
highlights:
## GPU clouds (neoclouds): the middle ground

These providers own or lease data center capacity and sell it with a real SLA, but without hyperscaler overhead.

RunPod: The widest range from hobby to production. Pods (rent a container), serverless endpoints, and now Instant Clusters of 16 to 64 GPUs self-serve, up to 512 through sales, at 3,200 Gbps between nodes for H100, H200 and B200. Secure Cloud lists L4 at $0.59, L40S $1.09, A100 80GB $1.79, H200 $5.29, B200 $7.99 and B300 $8.99.

Lambda: Built for ML teams. New prices take effect November 16, 2026: H100 SXM runs from $4.89 on a 1x instance to $4.59 on 8x, B200 from $7.99 to $7.69, and GH200 is $2.59. 1-Click Clusters now span 16 to 2,000+ H100 or B200 GPUs on two-week to one-year terms, with H100 from $6.16 per GPU-hour at 16 GPUs down to $5.54 at 256. Lambda's billing docs say filesystems are not charged for ingress or egress.

CoreWeave: Built for scale. Kubernetes-native, InfiniBand-connected clusters, where you go for hundreds of tightly wired GPUs. On-demand is priced high ($6.16 per H100), but spot drops an 8x H100 instance to $19.71 (about $2.46 per GPU), internet egress is free, and committed usage gets up to 60% off. It also lists GB200 NVL72 at $10.50 per GPU and B300 on spot only, about $4.48 per GPU.

Nebius: A full AI cloud with free managed Kubernetes and Soperator, its Slurm-on-Kubernetes. H100 is $4.50, H200 $5.40, B200 $8.50 and B300 $9.50, all billed per second. Preemptible capacity starts at $0.79 for H100 and H200, the lowest interruptible price we found. InfiniBand runs 400 Gbps per GPU, 3.2 Tbps per node, and egress is free.

Crusoe: H100 at $3.90 and H200 at $4.29 today, rising to $4.50 and $5.40 on December 1, 2026, which matches Nebius exactly. It lists SOC 2 Type I and II, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, charges no ingress or egress, and offers managed Kubernetes ($0.10 per cluster-hour) and managed Slurm.

Hyperstack: One of the cheapest dedicated clouds: H100 PCIe $2.50, SXM $3.20, H200 $3.99, B200 $6.00, with spot H100 at $2.00 and reservations from $1.75. Billed per minute with free egress. It shows a SOC 2 Type 2 badge and warns about a fraudulent lookalike domain.

Together AI: Best known for inference and fine-tuning APIs, it now sells GPU clusters with public prices: H100 $3.99 on-demand and $1.99 preemptible, H200 $5.99, B200 $8.19 and B300 $9.99. Reserved H100 falls from $3.69 for 3 to 30 days to $3.19 for 91 to 180 days.

results.title: Nvidia H100 Rental Price History and H200 Cost Trends 2026 | GPUSmith
highlights:
As of July 2026, renting a single Nvidia H100 GPU by the hour costs roughly $1.49 to $12.29 depending on provider, with a market median around $2.95 to $3.46 per GPU-hour [1] [2]. Specialist "neoclouds" such as Runpod ($2.89 to $2.99 per hour) [3], Vast.ai (marketplace rates from about $1.49 to $2.01) [4], and Hyperstack (from $2.60) undercut the three big hyperscalers by a wide margin: AWS lists its P5 instance at $6.88 per H100-hour [5], Microsoft Azure charges $6.98 to $12.29 depending on the source and commitment terms (Source: instances.vantage.sh) [5], and Google Cloud runs approximately $10.98 per GPU-hour on its a3-highgpu instances (Source: www.spheron.network). The gap between the cheapest neocloud and the priciest hyperscaler listing is commonly 6x to 9x for functionally identical Hopper-generation silicon [4].

The Nvidia H200, a memory-upgraded Hopper variant with 141 gigabytes (GB) of HBM3e versus the H100's 80GB, commands a modest premium over the H100 on most neoclouds, roughly $2.40 to $4.54 per GPU-hour [6], but a much steeper one from hyperscalers, up to $13.78 per GPU-hour on Azure [1]. H100 rental rates launched at approximately $4.70 per hour and spiked above $8 during the initial 2023 shortage (Source: www.latent.space), fell to roughly $2.85 by early 2024 (Source: www.latent.space), and continued sliding through 2025 as AWS cut on-demand P5 (H100) pricing by 44 percent and P5en (H200) pricing by 25 percent in June 2025 [7]. AIMultiple's Cloud GPU Rental Price Index, which tracks 63 providers and 17 GPU models monthly, pegs the H100 on-demand cohort median at approximately $2.99 per GPU-hour as of mid-2026, down from above $7 in early 2024, a roughly 58 percent two-year decline [6].

...

On-demand H100 pricing in July 2026 spans roughly an 8x range between the cheapest and most expensive publicly listed rate for a single 80GB H100 GPU. Independent aggregator GPU Cloud Cost, which states it is independent of every vendor it lists and carries no affiliate links, put the spread at $1.49 per hour (Vast.ai) to $12.29 per hour (AWS EC2), an 8.2x spread, as last verified in June 2026 [4]. GPU Tracker's own snapshot corroborates a similarly wide spread, from $0.80 per hour on the low end to $97.44 on the high end across its full catalog of listings, though the extreme high figure reflects atypical regional and multi-GPU-node edge cases rather than a representative single-GPU rate (Source: gputracker.dev). GetDeploying's tracker, which covers 45-plus providers for the H100 specifically, similarly frames the market as wide but bounded, noting that an 8x H100 node priced at $24.00 per hour on-demand works out to $3.00 per GPU-hour once normalized, a figure it uses as a worked example of why cross-provider comparisons must normalize multi-GPU nodes before drawing conclusions [15].

...

The H200's added memory carries a real but moderate premium on neoclouds and a much steeper one on hyperscalers. AIMultiple's index puts the H200's on-demand range from $2.30 (FluidStack) to $13.78 (Microsoft Azure), with a cohort median around $4.00 and a "working median" of $3 to $4 once community-tier and instance-share listings are set aside [6]. ByteCosts' provider-by-provider catalog corroborates the low end of that range, showing Vast.ai's cheapest confirmed on-demand H200 listing at $2.35 per GPU-hour in a French data center, with Nebius at $4.50, Google Cloud at $4.58, AWS at $7.91, and Oracle Cloud at $10.00 [20].

Runpod's own pricing page lists H200 SXM at $4.39 per hour directly [3], while CoreWeave's HGX H200 node lists at $50.44 per hour for 8 GPUs, or $6.31 normalized per GPU, with a spot price of $20.93 per hour for the node ($2.62 per GPU) [17]. Crusoe Cloud lists H200 HGX at $4.29 per GPU-hour on its own pricing page [18]. Alatirok's May 2026 analysis, sourced from the AIMultiple index, summarized the cross-generation comparison bluntly: an H100 runs roughly $2.69 to $2.95 on-demand on a neocloud, an H200 adds "a small premium for a big memory jump" at $3.39 to $3.50, while a Blackwell-generation B200 anchors the top of the modern-GPU tier at $5.24 [1].

# 英伟达B200算力报价创下阶段新高，涨幅是H200的6倍，供需极度紧张，市场几乎没有闲置卡，竞价抢货推高时租价格。 

 坚韧的君若伊0 

 2026年07月13日 03:02 广东 返回 中际旭创吧>

$中际旭创(SZ300308)$ 

一、价格数据（7月11日最新云端租赁报价）

1. B200 GPU

• 单价：6.69美元/每GPU小时，单日涨幅+8.8%

• 区间均价：4.70美元

• 最低价：3.33美元，当前已经摸到区间最高价

• 走势：一路单边走高，供不应求，报价持续冲高

2. H200 GPU

• 单价：4.27美元/每GPU小时，单日涨幅+1.4%

• 区间均价：3.59美元

• 历史最高价：7.01美元，冲高后小幅回落，当前维持高位

三、对应产业链结论

1. 高端新款GPU（B200）供给缺口更大，订单排期更长；

2. 算力租金持续上涨，下游模型厂商成本抬升，利润进一步向上游芯片、HBM存储、服务器硬件转移；

3. 资源竞价格局短期不会缓解，算力紧张至少延续至未来数年。

1. B200紧缺程度远超H200

B200算力报价创下阶段新高，涨幅是H200的6倍，供需极度紧张，市场几乎没有闲置卡，竞价抢货推高时租价格。

B200现价较区间均价高出42%，溢价明显，属于当前算力资源里最紧俏的型号。

2. 算力进入持续涨价周期，印证“算力通胀”

云端租赁价格持续上行，和肯·格里芬提到的现象完全对应：所有算力资源全天候满载，下游只能不断抬高报价抢产能。

需求远大于短期产能投放，租赁价格易涨难跌。
